name: video2book
description: Batch-transform Bilibili, YouTube, Douyin course videos & local media into publication-grade deep-dive textbooks and structured review notes.

interface.shortDescription: Turn Bilibili, YouTube, Douyin and local course videos into deep-dive textbooks and mindmap notes
interface.longDescription: Use Video2Book to rebuild long course videos into three linked deliverables: per-episode deep-dive articles, compiled modular textbooks, and mindmap-friendly review notes. The bundled toolchain ingests Bilibili, YouTube, Douyin and local media, extracts lightweight speech audio via ffmpeg, drives a two-pass semantic aggregation, and gates delivery with machine checks. Listening is delegated to the host: use the omni-media MCP tool read_audio when the model has a native audio modality, otherwise use read_media with an external multimodal model.
